openings.claim: The known spacer function may replace marker-only centering with repeatable lateral clearance: opposed corner spacer faces on removable brackets made from supplied strips, seated against the rim using bolts and rubber pads, without increased downward corner pressure. No strap function is proposed.
openings.discriminator: Against manually centering the untreated hatch, bounded clearance should reduce stipulated 4 mm displacement to at most 1 mm under 20 N. Corner lift persisting without increased downward pressure means lateral spacers have not resolved that disturbance. These are predictions, not observations.
openings.probe: Dry-fit four strips as two opposed corner brackets; check both lateral axes, rim engagement and removal. Drill/notch strips only. Proceed only if sideways loads can be resisted without modifying the fixture or obstructing the open aperture. Retain hatch, rim and seal; never drill, cut, glue or permanently deform them. Use no powered mechanism; recover all loose parts. Allocate ten closure/pull trials to ten spacer opening cycles, with the right-contact 1 mm card on final closure; add two untreated rival trials, one disturbed. Record position, 20 N displacement, corner lift, visible seal damage and full reopening time including bracket removal onto the tabletop. Require ten-cycle closure within 1 mm, 20 N resistance, one-technician reopening within 30 seconds, unobstructed opening and no new visible seal tears. Fabrication: ninety minutes; observation: twenty. Incomplete measurements defeat the probe even if stopped on time.
openings.uncertainty: Unspecified rim geometry may preclude padded bolted brackets/opposed faces. Four strips and six bolts may not suffice for clearance and 20 N reaction without permanent deformation; capacity is unmeasured. Timely removal and recoverability are unproven. The disturbed right contact may invalidate lateral seating or tear the seal. Any failed outcome defeats this configuration; only disturbed seal continuity is exempt.

lineage.reason: Preserves spacer relation, rival, defeat conditions, finite probe, resource caveats, assumptions and declared uncertain fit.

decision: Retain for conditional dry-fit investigation; no demonstrated performance or deployment. No constraint relaxation is authorized.
